title: Wynn Supports "Walk for a Million" with MOP 700,000 Donation

body_markdown:
**Macao, November** **24** **, 202** **6** **–**


Wynn has long been committed to giving back to the Macao community through its active participation in local charitable initiatives. This year, Wynn is continuing its support for the "Walk for a Million," organized by the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News, with a donation of MOP 700,000 to the fund. Wynn will also bring together more than a thousand team members and their family members to take part in the walk on December 13. Marking Wynn's 20th anniversary in Macao, participants will wear specially designed commemorative sportswear as they join local residents in walking for charity.


A


cheque presentation ceremony was held yesterday (Nov 24) at Wynn Palace. On behalf of Wynn, Ms. Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited; Mr. Frederic Luvisutto, Chief Operating Officer and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited; Ms. Stephanie So, Senior Vice President of Human Resources of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace; and Ms. Jasmine Cheong, Vice President of Community and Government Relations of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace, presented the cheque to the Charity Fund, represented by President Ms. Ho Teng Iat, Vice Presidents Mr. Lok Po, Mr. António José de Freitas and Mr. Hoi Kin Chong, President of the Directive Council Mr. Vong Kok Seng, Executive Vice Presidents of the Directive Council Ms. Ho Hoi Leng and Mr. Kong Kin Hou, and Chief Supervisor Mr. Iau Kam Hoi.


Ms. Ho Teng Iat expressed heartfelt appreciation to Wynn for its long-term support for the Charity Fund. She noted that the Fund has consistently advanced charitable initiatives and supported underprivileged communities under the tenet of "All for one and one for all," guided by the principles of "giving back to the community and ensuring the proper use of donations." As this year marks the commencement of both the Nation's 15th Five-Year Plan and Macao's Third FiveYear Plan, the Fund will continue to unite community efforts to strengthen social support services and foster a more harmonious and inclusive society.


Ms. Linda Chen said that the "Walk for a Million" has brought together people from across Macao for charity over the years, and that Wynn is pleased to continue supporting the event. This year, a total of 1,400 Wynn team members and their families have registered to walk alongside the wider community, which is a meaningful way for Wynn to mark 20 years of growing with Macao and carry forward its longstanding commitment to local charitable causes. She added that the long-term success of a business is closely tied to the well-being and harmony of the community it serves. That belief has long guided Wynn's commitment to caring for the community and helping those in need. Wynn will continue working with partners from all sectors of society to uphold Macao's spirit of solidarity and mutual support, contributing to a more inclusive and harmonious future for the city.
